deployments_detail.use: Microchip ChatBot on microchipdirect.com storefront/contact pages: an AI chatbot (labeled BETA) that assists customers with Microchip products, orders, part details, and technical inquiries. Live and deployed on the customer-facing site. [none]

MPLAB AI Coding Assistant: a VS Code extension that generates context-aware embedded C code, does inline error detection/debug, and vectorizes Microchip datasheets for in-IDE retrieval. Built on the open-source Continue extension and preconfigured with Microchip's proprietary LLM, continuously retrained on Microchip docs. Launched Feb 2025, free download with paid advanced tiers; AI agents added Sep 2025. [Continue (open source) + Microchip proprietary LLM]

Internal use of the MPLAB AI Coding Assistant behind Microchip's firewall by its own engineers and by support engineers helping customers, run for over a year before public launch to validate measurable productivity gains. [Continue + Microchip proprietary LLM]
End-to-end edge AI/ML platforms for microcontrollers/MPUs/FPGAs (vision, audio, predictive maintenance)

MPLAB Machine Learning Development Suite: an AutoML-powered toolkit (MPLAB X plug-in) that automates building small-footprint ML models for embedded deployment on Microchip MCUs/MPUs/dsPIC DSCs, supporting TensorFlow Lite. Offered free to developers. [Microchip AutoML; TensorFlow Lite]

VectorBlox Accelerator SDK: software-based CNN/neural-network inference engine for deploying edge-AI vision and sensor models on PolarFire FPGAs and SoCs without FPGA reprogramming; supports sparse networks. Public SDK (v3.1) on GitHub, in production release. [Microchip VectorBlox]

Edge Impulse MLOps integration into MPLAB X IDE: a plug-in that lets engineers stream training data from Microchip 8/32-bit MCUs and MPUs to Edge Impulse to build, evaluate and deploy TinyML models on-device. Live integration since 2020, extended to 32-bit MPUs in 2024. [Edge Impulse]

Production-ready full-stack edge AI application packages: pre-trained, modifiable models for electrical arc-fault detection, predictive maintenance/condition monitoring, biometric facial recognition with liveness detection, and voice keyword spotting, deployable on Microchip MCUs/MPUs. [Microchip + unnamed software partners]

Smart Factory predictive-maintenance solution: a neural-network / embedded-sensor demonstration app using the MPLAB Machine Learning Development Suite with the dsPIC LVMC motor control board to predict equipment maintenance issues for Industry 4.0 motor condition monitoring. [Microchip MPLAB ML (AutoML)]
